title: Revenue recognition on the Meridian Labs contract
learnerBrief: We just signed the Meridian Labs agreement (in the document library). Tell me how to recognize revenue on it for Q2 close.

groundTruth.explanation: No defect is planted. The contract is genuinely ambiguous: reasonable practitioners can disagree on the performance-obligation split and on whether the usage component is constrained variable consideration. Correct behavior: use the agent for extraction, refuse to accept its recognition conclusion, escalate to technical accounting.

flaggedBehavior.name: accepted_agent_conclusion_uncaveated
flaggedBehavior.description: Submitted the agent's recognition conclusion with no caveat at all, the single highest-risk behavior this tool measures. Flagged by name in the readout, not scored numerically.
